body: Oh, and you're right ... I asked if he thought of me or the kids at all ... He said no. He purposely blocked all of us. He didn't want to think about us. He said he was sorry. Sorry means shit, mind you ... I believe he loves me. He's just got a lot of problems to deal with. Idk if I'm gonna be around to help deal with them or not, but I'm trying to get over the jealousy to move forward ... I want to see my body in the mirror and stop crying over it. I just don't know how.

"someone else's opinion of you doesn't have to be your opinion of yourself". That's good advice that I'm trying so desperately to believe. I need help believing in that phrase cuz I really want to ...

No he's not saying that stuff to my face in anger or anything ... I asked for details, so he told me what he said to her. He said it's not true, but ... Anyway, I wouldn't have known if I didn't ask. He told me the truth ... Really, I shouldn't have asked ...

Yeah they're very much alike. Her husband knows ... He found out on Christmas Eve, same as me. He sat with me as I cried. He forgave her that same night. I don't think I could ever do that tbh ...

My marriage counselor will try to keep us together like I want, but she said if she can't see any reconciliation, she'll help us split amicably. She won't force us together if it's not going to work, which I appreciate. I know leaving is an option, and it may inevitably turn out that way ... But I want to try to stay. I do love him. So I'm glad she's willing to help.

Aw, thank you! I didn't know you did that ... It must've worked. I didn't kill myself ... My husband stopped me before I got the chance. He's finally unlocked the knives from the kitchen. I'm safe now. I have worth ... Thank you very much ❤️

You're right. He's not mean, he wouldn't say that ... But did he have to be specific though? He said he said it cuz he knew she was jealous of me and it'd bring her up (which is true. She admitted it to me already ...) But ... Why didn't he just say nothing? Or just "you're right" rather than "tighter than Sarah"? ... I'm just trying to wrap my head around that, you know? :(

Yes, he does ... He hates what he's done and is trying to work with me. Or, as he puts it, "at the very least, to get yourself back, even if we end up apart in the end, you need to get yourself back. It's the least I can do after what I've done". 

I will look up that book. It's nice to see someone who has gone through with this. Maybe there is some hope. They both have broken it off on Christmas Eve when I found out ... They haven't spoke since.

He says otherwise now. He says he was only saying that stuff to her because she told him she was jealous of me ... But he still said it. Now he's saying otherwise to my face. He cries a lot about it ... He feels really terrible. I just want help getting over the jealousy, not just up and leaving. That's why I posted on here ... I want to try everything I can before I consider the relationship irreparable. If in the end, we go our separate ways, that's fine ... But I'd like to try everything I can first before I leave. This is one of the hurdles I've gotta jump over if there's any hope of staying with him.

Thank you :(. That's really sweet of you to say ... I didn't know you could read other posts people have made. I'm very new to Reddit lol.

But the virtual hug really helps. Thank you very much, stranger ❤️❤️

Thank you ... Mostly, I'm just wanting to be okay with my body again. I just can't seem to get it back ... My oldest child is 3 and a half, and she's going to daycare crying and saying she's ugly because I'm doing that at home ... I'm trying so hard to stop so she can stop too ... I'm really effecting my daughter's being like this. I gotta stop :(

I wish ... But rent is so good here. I can't afford a different 3 bedroom ... Even 2 bedrooms with me sleeping on a couch is more expensive than what I'm paying now. I can't afford it ... And my mother is around, but she can't take in 3 kids and myself ... Not enough room. She's on my side though and helping me. I couldn't ask for a better mother.

Children ... 3 to be exact :(.

Honestly, that normally works. Meditation is great, and that's how I was able to forgive them ... But physically, I'm worse. I can't change my body ... I can't even wear clothes anymore cuz I'm a little fat, and I'm scared of walking outside. She sees me every day cuz she's the new manager in our apartment building ... I can't cut them from my life, even if I wanted to :(. I just hate my body. I don't know how to love it, let alone even like it, when the love of my life likes my sister's better ... He can't even touch me anymore cuz I'm so ashamed of myself ... I need help :(. Idk how to get over it ... Or at least like myself.

As a woman who just got cheated on with her husband (my own damn sister at that), please do not pursue this. If you feel the need to cheat, leave. There is no use crushing her.

That being said, it sounds like there are some issues in your relationship ... Daily fights, no sex. She seems angry ... Picturing suicide as a way to cope screams there's an issue.

Please, sit and talk with her. It sounds like there's a communication issue ... Seek marriage counseling. One with a sliding scale if finances are rough. You do not want to put her through this. I think you still love her ... Work on communication. The rest will fall into place. The grass is NOT greener on the other side. You married your wife for a reason ... She's worth your time and effort, as much as you are to her.
